dct_title_s: Minneapolis basic map series : issue, December 1938
dct_alternative_sm: Minneapolis basic map series : issue, December 1938
dct_description_sm: Maps of the thirteen wards of Minneapolis plus one base map.

Shows ward boundary lines, district corners and block numbers, section corners, and selected property denominations.; Additional title devised by cataloger.; ""Note: Districts and blocks as used early in 1930 by the U.S. Census; adjusted and brought up to date, thereafter to comply with ward boundary changes of December 30, 1930.""; ""District corners and block numbers: C.W.A. Building and Housing Survey 1933/34.""; ""Delineated by W. Gumbrill.""; ""O.P. 465-71-3-80.""; ""Works Project number 5435, City Planning Surveys. Subdivision 3, 'Land utility and building trends'. Unit 8, revision and production of ward map series.; Inv. no. 851 (First Ward) - inv. no. 863 (Thirteenth Ward).; Blueprint (white lines on blue background).; Library copy bears editing and correction marks in red and yellow pencil.
